concerns.text: FR-001 (Ingest ARC-Bench & annotate) lacks a dedicated task for the actual annotation logic. T011b is tagged [FR-001] but is marked as unchecked `[ ]` and described as 'Artifact Generation' for a script that 'read... annotate... and write'. However, T036 (Streaming Data Loader) and T050 (Verification) are checked `[X]` but do not perform the annotation. The critical step of generating the `annotated_structural_feature` field (the core of FR-001) relies entirely on the unchecked T011b. If T011b is not implemented, FR-001 is unmet.

FR-002 (CPU-tractable model distillation) relies on T013 (distill_rules.py) which is marked `[X]` but T043 (Validate Model Quantization) is marked `[ ]` (unchecked). T013 explicitly depends on T043 to ensure the model is INT4. Without T043, the constraint of 'CPU-tractable' (FR-002) is not verified before execution, creating a risk of violating the resource constraint.

FR-004 (Execute on stratified sample) and SC-001/SC-002 (Time-to-Pivot/Success Rate) rely on T019a (generate_manifest.py) and T019 (run_experiments.py). Both T019a and T019 are marked `[ ]` (unchecked). T019a is critical for creating the stratified sample required by FR-004. Without these tasks, the experiment cannot be executed as specified.

FR-006 (Mixed-effects logistic regression) and SC-003 (Significance of interaction) rely on T026a (Model Fitting) and T026b (Significance Determination). Both are marked `[ ]` (unchecked). T025 (statistical_model.py) is checked, but without T026a/b, the specific outputs (p-values, significance determination) required by FR-006 and SC-003 are not generated.

FR-007 (Categorize failed pivots) relies on T027 (error_taxonomy.py) and T027b (Execute & Populate). Both are marked `[ ]` (unchecked). Without these, the distinction between 'Coverage Gap' and 'Distillation Error' (FR-007) is not performed.

SC-001 (Time-to-Pivot difference) and SC-002 (Success Rate stratified) rely on T029a (Tobit Regression) and T029b (Stratified Rates). Both are marked `[ ]` (unchecked). T029c and T029d are also unchecked. The analysis required to measure these success criteria is missing.
SC-004 (Proportion of Coverage Gap vs Distillation Error) relies on T027b (Execute & Populate) which is unchecked. The metric cannot be calculated without this task.

SC-005 (Total compute time) relies on T030b (Resource Logging - Entire Experiment) which is checked `[X]`, but T030a (Resource Logging - Local) is also checked. However, T030b depends on T013, T017, T021. T017 and T021 are checked, but T013 is checked. The dependency chain seems intact, but the actual execution of the analysis tasks (T026, T027, T029) which generate the data for the report (T029f) is missing. T029f (Generate Final Report) is checked, but it depends on T026b, T029c, T029d, T027b, T030b, T047. Since T026b, T029c, T029d, T027b are unchecked, T029f cannot produce a valid report.

T056 is tagged as a 'Revision Task' but references a 'quickstart run-book' and 'execution_feedback.md' which are not present in the provided inputs (spec.md, plan.md, tasks.md). While the task itself is valid for fixing a run-book mismatch, the reference to external feedback files not in the context suggests a stale tag or a missing input artifact. The task description assumes the existence of `.specify/memory/execution_feedback.md` which is not provided.
